values.note: Trailer size varies by site: some take trailers up to 35 ft, others only 25 ft. One RV and two tents, or three tents, a site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/elbert-creek-campground ('a first-come, first-served campground with 17 sites'; 'Some sites can hold trailers up to 35 feet, while others can only hold 25 feet'; 'A maximum of three tents or one RV and two tents is allowed per site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water, trash and a host may not be available early and late in the season. Firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/elbert-creek-campground ('Vault toilets are available in the campground'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'Services such as water, trash or a host may not be available during early and late season') + recreation.gov 10165280 notice ('Firewood is available for sale at host site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Generally open May through September, weather dependent (FS). recreation.gov's 2026 first-come fee season ran May 22 - Sept 19 (2027: May 21 - Sept 18).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/elbert-creek-campground ('The facility is generally open May through September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165280/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-19), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come only: arrive to claim and pay for a site. Pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check or money order) or by Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app, downloaded before arriving (patchy cell service). A first-come site must be occupied the first night. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.; up to eight people a site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/elbert-creek-campground ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site'; 'A self-service fee tube is available'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the first night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165280 (Scan and Pay overview), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 a site including two vehicles (an RV with its tow vehicle counts as one); a third vehicle, or a boat/ATV trailer, is $11 a night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/elbert-creek-campground ('$26 nightly fee per site for overnight camping, which includes two vehicles. A third vehicle is an additional $11 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165280/rates (2026 and 2027 First-come season ScanPay1 26), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/elbert-creek-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: ~10,000 ft beside the Mount Elbert and Mount Massive trailheads on the dirt Halfmoon Rd (FSR 110; graded, 2WD to the campground; not maintained in winter). Very popular with hikers; altitude sickness is possible. --Claude

Road/closure check: Forest Order 02-12-01-26-39 (Willow Fire Area Closure, Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026) closes NFS land 'continuing on the North side of Halfmoon Creek to the East boundary of the Forest'. The campground and Halfmoon Rd lie on the south side of the creek on imagery, so it does not appear to be inside the closure; the FS page gives no closure notice. Halfmoon Rd is dirt and 'not maintained in the winter'; no RV or 4WD advice on the FS page.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): no per-site points (recreation.gov lists only a Scan & Pay placeholder). On imagery Halfmoon Creek runs ~50-100 m north of the road with the campground spurs between, so some sites may be near the creek; not re-audited here.
